patterns.note: Consistent use of multi-column grids for displaying artworks, partners, and articles, often with a 'View More' link for navigation.
A strong contrast between elegant, large serif headings for primary messaging and clean, legible sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
A minimalist black, white, and gray color scheme is punctuated by a vibrant emerald green for calls-to-action and key interactive elements.
A top promotional banner dismisses on scroll, while the main header (logo and 'Join Peggy' CTA) becomes a sticky element at the top of the viewport after a short scroll.
Repeated section structure featuring a prominent title, sometimes a 'View More' link, and a grid of related items (e.g., artworks, artists, partners, articles).

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-width video background with overlaid text and calls-to-action, ensuring high visual impact upon page load.
Content sections are organized into distinct blocks with alternating light and dark backgrounds (white, light gray, black) to visually separate information.
Interactive elements like buttons and input fields use subtle rounded corners and a consistent accent color for their primary state, with clear hover effects.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and some interactive elements, while image cards and section containers are mostly sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with ample whitespace in the hero section, transitioning to a more structured and well-spaced grid layout for content sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a sophisticated, almost editorial serif typeface for primary headings, paired with a clean sans-serif, creates a premium, gallery-like feel. This typographic choice, combined with a minimalist color palette and strong visual focus on art, elevates the brand beyond a typical marketplace to an art authority.
